Markets.title: Cleveland Fed's Hammack backs restrictive policy, says better if it comes 'relatively quickly'
Markets.summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack supports implementing restrictive monetary policy quickly to combat widespread inflation. She emphasizes the need for prompt adjustments and policy transparency to help households and businesses plan amid rising prices.

Markets.title: US Stocks: Dating app Bumble shares surge 52% on talks to go private at $1 billion valuation
Markets.summary: Bumble shares surged 52% following reports of advanced negotiations to be acquired privately by Ithaca Holdings. The potential deal would value the dating app company at approximately $1 billion, up from its recent market valuation of about $389 million.

Markets.title: US bank stocks near correction as earnings loom, consumer outlook in focus
Markets.summary: US bank stocks are nearing correction territory ahead of their upcoming earnings reports. Investors are closely watching for consumer resilience amid higher borrowing costs and rising Treasury yields.

Markets.title: Polycab India’s F&O exit: NSE sets December 30 deadline; NCLAT stays insolvency order
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange will remove Polycab India from its equity derivatives segment on December 30, 2026. Meanwhile, the NCLAT has stayed an insolvency order against the company regarding a disputed operational debt.

Markets.title: Indian Gas Exchange secures Sebi's nod to float IPO
Markets.summary: Indian Gas Exchange has received regulatory approval from Sebi to launch an initial public offering. The upcoming IPO consists entirely of an offer for sale of equity shares by its promoter, Indian Energy Exchange.

Markets.title: Singularity AMC pays over Rs 40 lakh to settle AIF rule violation case with Sebi
Markets.summary: Singularity AMC paid Rs 40.5 lakh to settle Alternative Investment Fund rule violation cases with the Securities and Exchange Board of India. The infractions involved failing to maintain the required interest in the Singularity Equity Fund and making excessive drawdowns across three areas.

Geo-Political.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy stated that Russia has struck six Ukrainian energy sites since the U.S. president announced a ceasefire protecting energy infrastructure. Despite the announcement, these targeted attacks on Ukraine's energy facilities have continued.

Geo-Political.title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: An investigation by the BBC revealed that Russian oligarch Roman Abramovich used backdated paperwork to hide his yachts and mansions from financial accounts. The falsified documents were created to evade taxes on his wealth.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
Geo-Political.summary: A Saudi minister promised a serious response after Houthi attacks on two airports killed 13 people. This incident represents a significant military escalation by the armed group.

Geo-Political.title: South Africa's deputy police chief resigns after being charged with sexual offences
Geo-Political.summary: South Africa's deputy police chief, Shadrack Sibiya, has resigned after being charged with sexual offenses. He has denied allegations of grooming a 16-year-old and raping an 18-year-old.

Geo-Political.title: Immigration agents search Congresswoman Ilhan Omar's home
Geo-Political.summary: Immigration agents searched the home of Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar. Omar, a frequent critic of Donald Trump, called the search an attempt to target political enemies and stated she will not be silenced.

Geo-Political.title: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack
Geo-Political.summary: A cyber attack targeted the refrigeration systems in hundreds of French supermarkets overnight. The hack spoiled fresh and frozen food worth millions of euros.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A content creator tested AI traffic generation and found that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies toward AI optimization (AIO) over traditional search engine optimization (SEO).

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help creators stay competitive and simplify their daily digital workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create digital media. The tool also provides features that allow creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: India, UK to exchange tariff usage data under trade agreement
Data & Insights.summary: India and the UK will begin exchanging annual tariff usage data in July 2027 under their trade agreement. This initiative aims to help small businesses benefit from lower import duties and resolve early operational challenges.

Data & Insights.title: US tariffs accelerate global trade realignment: How India’s FTAs could boost GDP
Data & Insights.summary: Bloomberg Economics reports that India's expanding free trade agreements could increase its GDP by $140 billion and boost exports by 6.2% by 2035. This projected growth is driven by US tariffs and global supply chain shifts that are accelerating international trade realignment.

Data & Insights.title: FTAs may add $140bn to India GDP by 2035, lift exports 6.2%: Bloomberg Economics
Data & Insights.summary: Bloomberg Economics estimates that free trade agreements could increase India's GDP by $140 billion and boost exports by 6.2% by 2035. These economic gains could rise to $170 billion if India successfully finalizes ongoing trade negotiations with the US, EAEU, GCC, and Israel.

Data & Insights.title: India sees 5% drop in job postings in Q2, fares better than major economies: Bain & Company
Data & Insights.summary: India's job postings decreased by 5% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, though the country performed better than major global economies. Meanwhile, global job openings for artificial intelligence increased by 60% to approximately 351,000.

Data & Insights.title: AI could lift India’s GDP growth by 0.4–0.9 percentage point annually. Which jobs and industries stand to gain?
Data & Insights.summary: Artificial intelligence could increase India's annual GDP growth by 0.4 to 0.9 percentage point, depending on infrastructure improvements and IT industry advancements. However, experts warn that automation without job creation could worsen unemployment and economic inequality.

Data & Insights.title: Inflation breaches RBI’s 4% target for fourth straight month
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to a 23-month high of 5.54% in September, breaching the RBI's 4% target for the fourth consecutive month. Driven by escalating food and commodity costs, this inflation surge complicates the central bank's efforts to stabilize prices.

India.title: 14 'Defects' In Rahul Gandhi's Petition, Rs 220 Shortfall Flagged By Supreme Court
India.summary: The Supreme Court flagged 14 errors in a petition filed by Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and other opposition leaders challenging alleged electoral irregularities and the Special Intensive Revision of voter rolls. The court also noted a Rs 220 shortfall in the required filing fees.

India.title: Delhi SIR: 20 Lakh Cases Resolved After 33 Lakh Voters Get Notices
India.summary: Authorities issued notices to 33 million voters in Delhi as part of a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process. Booth-level officers have resolved 2 million of these cases with the help of special assistance camps.

India.title: 4 Dead, 1 Injured As EV Bursts Into Flames After Hitting Divider In Andhra
India.summary: An electric vehicle struck a divider in Andhra Pradesh, causing a fire that completely destroyed the car. Four occupants died at the scene, and one other person was critically injured.

India.title: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, 3 Other States Get New Governors
India.summary: Om Prakash Mathur, currently the Governor of Sikkim, will replace Arlekar as the new Governor of Kerala. This appointment is part of a broader reshuffle involving new Governors appointed across six Indian states, including Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Karnataka.

India.title: Maharashtra Man Takes Lover On Date To Waterfall, Then Pushes Her Into It
India.summary: A Maharashtra man pushed his lover into a waterfall during a date, leading to her death. Her body was recovered from a depth of about 1,000 feet and sent for a post-mortem examination.

India.title: Bangla Sahib Row: Police Case Aganst Arvind Kejriwal, AAP Goes To Akal Takht
India.summary: Punjab AAP legislators approached the Akal Takht seeking action after Delhi Police personnel allegedly entered the Bangla Sahib Gurudwara wearing shoes and with uncovered heads. This followed a police case filed against AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal over the incident.

General.title: Burnham to push for new post-Brexit deals at EU summit
General.summary: Andy Burnham will push for new post-Brexit deals at an upcoming European Union summit. In response, Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch accused the prime minister of unpicking the UK's previous agreement with the EU.

General.title: Government expands police support to political figures who are not MPs
General.summary: The UK government is expanding police support to political figures who are not members of Parliament. Justice Secretary Shabana Mahmood stated that current security measures provide insufficient protection for individuals playing a role in public life.

General.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
General.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy states that Russia has attacked six Ukrainian energy sites since U.S. President Trump announced a halt on energy infrastructure targeting. These strikes have continued despite the previous agreement to spare such facilities.

General.title: Watch: What could Trump's energy ceasefire mean for Ukraine?
General.summary: Ukrainians are facing another winter of electricity outages amid ongoing Russian attacks. The BBC's Dan Johnson reports from Kyiv on what a potential energy ceasefire proposed by Donald Trump could mean for the country.
